newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana stock exchange closes up in improved volume.
newsitem.headline: Ghana stock exchange closes up in improved volume.

text.p: The Ghanaian stock exchange edged higher on Thursday and volume improved slightly compared with recent sessions, dealers said.
The GSE all-share index rose 0.57 point to 386.15.
The market does not usually trade on Thursday, except when a holiday falls on the normal Wednesday trading day.
The volume of shares traded shot up to 65,770 compared to just 16,200 last Monday.
Mobil Oil Ghana Limited (MOGL) led the gainers with a rise of 50 cedis to 6,450 cedis, while Standard Chartered Bank added 40 to 5,050.
Ghana Commercial Bank (GCB) was the only loser, down five cedis at 655, but 10 stocks were unchanged and another six of the 21 listed shares did not trade.
